statements.sql:
SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "CustomerID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_customers"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "ProductID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "ProductID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_products"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "SalesOrderDetailID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SalesOrderDetailID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_details"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("OrderDate") as min_date,
  MAX("OrderDate") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_details"
UNION ALL
SELECT
  1 as table_index,
  MIN("OrderDate") as min_date,
  MAX("OrderDate") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"

SELECT "ProductID", "Color"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_products"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "ProductID" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ProductID", "Name", "ProductNumber", "MakeFlag", "FinishedGoodsFlag", "SafetyStockLevel", "ReorderPoint", "StandardCost", "ListPrice", "Size", "SizeUnitMeasureCode", "WeightUnitMeasureCode", "Weight", "DaysToManufacture", "ProductLine", "Class", "Style", "ProductSubcategoryID", "ProductModelID", "SellStartDate", "SellEndDate", "DiscontinuedDate", "ModifiedDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_products"
  ON "ProductID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "SalesOrderID", "SalesOrderDetailID", "CarrierTrackingNumber", "OrderQty", "ProductID", "SpecialOfferID", "UnitPrice", "UnitPriceDiscount", "LineTotal", "ModifiedDate", "CustomerID", "OrderDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_sales_order_details"
  ON "ProductID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "OrderDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "OrderDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "OrderDate" <= ?
  AND "OrderDate" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "OrderDate" DESC, "SalesOrderDetailID"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "OrderDate" DESC, "SalesOrderDetailID"

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "CustomerID", "PersonID", "StoreID", "TerritoryID", "AccountNumber", "ModifiedDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."adventureworks_customers"
  ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
